Same ratchet contract as a11y-baseline.json: every entry names one axe rule,
the pass ('dark') and the fixture-section slugs it applies to, plus a
node-level predicate (contrast or htmlIncludes). A violation is suppressed
only when EVERY one of its nodes matches an exception; an exception with no
predicate is rejected at load time.
